caption: Houseboats moored in Sausalito, California.
alt: Color photograph of colorful houseboats moored side by side on calm water, with wooded hills in the background.
credit: Wikimedia Commons, photo by an anonymous contributor, released CC0
note: The San Francisco Oracle is still under copyright, so no page of it is used. The 1967 Houseboat Summit conversation between Leary, Ginsberg, Snyder, and Watts took place on a houseboat at Sausalito's Gate 5/Waldo Point; this is a modern photograph (not from 1967) of the same houseboat community, center-cropped square from a landscape original.
